title: BPMN Server settings
description: Every setting: .env (x-where env) and settings/config.ts (x-where config, named config:<path>). The x- keywords: docs/design/setup-wizard.md.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: **A secret.** Set, a server with no users creates the user `admin` with it. Unset (the default), its first page asks for the administrator, with a setup token it prints: [The first start](setup.md#the-first-start). A server that has users already is not changed

AI_ACCESS.description: The levels of AI links (`/ai/key`) this server offers: `off`, or some of `work`, `design`, `administer`, comma separated. Unset: all. A person is offered only the levels their rights allow. See [Chatting with your server](ai/chat-assistants.md)

AI_GUIDE.description: A Markdown file: this site's own guide for AI agents, in its `/llms.txt`. Default `settings/ai-guide.md`

AI_KEY_TTL_GROUPS.description: How long a user's link for an AI agent (`/ai/key`) lasts, in minutes, by group: `{"ADMIN":10,"staff":60}`. A user in several of the groups gets the shortest; in none, 30 minutes. See [Chatting with your server](ai/chat-assistants.md)

AUTH_RATE_LIMIT.description: Sign-in attempts allowed in the rate window. Default `50`

DISABLE_DESIGN.description: `true`: no model editor or test runs, and **no test calls on the engine**. Set it on both for production

ENFORCE_SECURITY.description: On unless set to `false` (`init` writes `true`). `false` turns off sign-in and the security rules: for development only

ELEMENT_TEMPLATES.description: `on` offers the application's element templates (configured tasks) in the model editor and lists them on the Design page. Off by default in 3.7.1: a preview, to be finished (docs/design/roadmap.md)

NOTIFICATIONS.description: Notification policies (docs/design/notification-policies.md): `record` keeps every notification in wf_notifications without delivering it (the application's notify is not called), for a test or staging server; unset, they are delivered (a test run's are only kept)

SECURITY_POLICY.description: Security policies (docs/design/security-policies.md): unset, they are on when the models folder has `policies/security/`; `default` turns them on with the built-in default policy; `off` turns them off

REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATION.description: On unless set to `false` (`init` writes `true`). `false` turns off sign-in and the security rules: for development only

SESSION_SECRET.description: **A secret, required in production.** Secures sessions and CSRF tokens

SIGNUP_GROUPS.description: Sign-up sends a verification email, and gives these groups once verified

SIGNUP_VERIFY_EMAIL.description: Sign-up sends a verification email, and gives these groups once verified

API_ACTING_USER_KEY.description: **A secret.** Turns on `/api2/tasks`. Must differ from `API_KEY`

API_IMPERSONATION.description: `true`: `/api` acts as the user a call names (`userName`, or `options.userName`), with no security rules, as before 3.7. For integrations that need time to move to `/api2/tasks`; goes at 4.0. Default off: the name is ignored, and the answer's `Warning` header says so

API_KEY.description: **A secret, required in production.** Runs processes

API_RATE_LIMIT.description: Calls a minute one address may make to the APIs (`/api`, `/api2`, `/api/v3`, the administration APIs); over it, `429`. Unset, no limit

API_SERVICE_MODELS_OWNER.description: The tenant and models owner of that account

API_SERVICE_TENANT_ID.description: The tenant and models owner of that account

API_SERVICE_USER_GROUPS.description: Who `/api` and `/api2` calls run as. `init` sets `integration` and `SYSTEM`; without them, those APIs answer 500

API_SERVICE_USER_NAME.description: Who `/api` and `/api2` calls run as. `init` sets `integration` and `SYSTEM`; without them, those APIs answer 500

BPMN_ENV_FILE.description: `bpmn-mcp` only: another file to read in place of `.env`

HOST.description: Where the server is. `HOST` defaults to `localhost` for `bpmn-mcp`

DATABASE.description: `sqlite:<file>` keeps everything (instances, models, users, sessions) in one SQLite file, such as `sqlite:./data/bpmn.sqlite`: no database server (Node 22.5 or later). Unset: MongoDB, at `MONGO_DB_URL`

DEFINITIONS_PATH.description: The models folder, in place of the one in `settings/config.ts`. Used for tests and separate deployments

MONGO_DB_NAME.description: The database's name, when the URL has none

MONGO_DB_URL.description: **Required, unless `DATABASE` is SQLite.** The MongoDB database, or `memory` to try without one

API_TRACE.description: A file: every API call (`/api`, `/api2`) and its answer, one JSON line each (when, how long, method, path, status, the kind of credential, the bodies cut at `API_TRACE_MAX` characters, default 4000, with passwords, keys and tokens masked). To see what a client, an AI agent, did. Off by default

API_TRACE_MAX.description: With API_TRACE: the most characters of a request or answer body kept. Default `4000`

ENABLE_PROFILER.description: `true` turns on the database profiler for queries

EMAIL_FROM.description: The account they're sent through. The password is a secret

EMAIL_LOG.description: A file that also gets each message

SMTP_PASSWORD.description: The account they're sent through. The password is a secret

SMTP_USER.description: The account they're sent through. The password is a secret

DEMO_MODE.description: `true` gives `TIMERS`, `SERVICE_TASKS`, `SCRIPT_SANDBOX` and `SCRIPT_SANDBOX_SERVICES` their public demo values, unless they are set

ENGINE_AT.description: The engine's address. Unset or `local`: in this process. `none`: no engine

ENGINE_KEY.description: **A secret.** Required for a separate engine

ENGINE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long running executions get to finish on shutdown. Default `10000`

ENGINE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: How long to wait for an answer. Default and most `300000`, five minutes. The call isn't tried again: the engine may still be running it

LOCK_MAX_TRIES.description: Instance locks: time between tries, tries before giving up, and the age at which a lock is taken over

LOCK_RETRY_DELAY_MS.description: Instance locks: time between tries, tries before giving up, and the age at which a lock is taken over

LOCK_STALE_AFTER_MS.description: Instance locks: time between tries, tries before giving up, and the age at which a lock is taken over

PYTHON_CMD.description: The command that runs Python scripts. Default `python`

SCRIPT_SANDBOX.description: `true` runs scripts in a sandbox, and lets sandboxed scripts call services

SCRIPT_SANDBOX_SERVICES.description: `true` runs scripts in a sandbox, and lets sandboxed scripts call services

SERVER_ID.description: This process's name in the locks it takes

SERVICE_TASKS.description: `false` stops timers or service tasks from running

TIMERS.description: `false` stops timers or service tasks from running

CONNECTORS_ALLOW_HOSTS.description: A comma list of the hosts connectors may call

CONNECTORS_KEY.description: **A secret.** Encrypts connectors' keys. Required to give a connector a key, and keep it: backups need the same one

MODEL_HISTORY.description: `false` keeps no saved versions of models

VERIFY_MODELS_ON_IMPORT.description: `warn`, `enforce` or `off`, for models saved through the APIs

APP_ENV.description: The environment: `test` makes the sample application use its test services (`connectors/testServices.ts`: the same names, nothing sent or recorded); `/llms.txt` says which. Default: production

DOCS_PATH.description: The folder of the docs pages the server shows

ITSM_HOST.description: The origin allowed to call the server from a browser (CORS)

NODE_ENV.description: `production` stops the server from starting with unsafe settings: see [Security](security.md)

RESTART_ON_EXIT.description: `true`: something restarts this process when it exits

SECURE_COOKIES.description: Cookies only over HTTPS, when something in front of the server handles it

SERVE.description: `both`, `api` (the REST APIs only) or `ui` (the web pages only)

SITE_NAME.description: The name and address used in emails

SITE_URL.description: The name and address used in emails

config:locks.maxTries.description: tries before a lock gives up (20)

config:locks.staleAfter.description: milliseconds after which a lock or timer claim is stale and another server may take it (300000)

config:serverId.description: this server's identity as a lock owner (default `SERVER_ID`, else the host, the process id and a random suffix)

config:shutdownTimeout.description: how long `shutdown()` waits for running executions, in milliseconds (10000)

config:timers.forceTimersDelay.description: milliseconds; every timer fires after this delay (for testing). When `timers` is not given at all, the default is `{ forceTimersDelay: 1000, precision: 3000 }`: give `timers` in production

config:timers.pollInterval.description: milliseconds between re-reads of waiting timers, so a timer another server scheduled fires here when that server is gone (default 60000; 0: never)

config:timers.precision.description: milliseconds; timers due within it fire together
